 Villareal vs Paris Saint-Germain: Predicted starting lineup for Champions League match 
 Who will make it into the starting lineup as PSG prepare to face La Liga side Villareal at La Ceramica in Champions League? By Alan Mezoela | Nov 2, 2026, 5:48 AM EST Share on Facebook Share on X Share on Reddit Copy Article Add us as a preferred source Le Havre AC v Paris Saint-Germain - Ligue 1 McDonald's 2026/27 | Xavier Laine/GettyImages After a dominant 5-1 away victory over relegation-threatened Le Havre , Luis Enrique and Paris Saint-Germain are preparing to face Spanish side Villareal in their fourth League Phase game of the season.
--> After a dominant 5-1 away victory over relegation-threatened Le Havre , Luis Enrique and Paris Saint-Germain are preparing to face Spanish side Villareal in their fourth League Phase game of the season.
 The Parisians have secured three victories to start their Champions League campaign, including two wins over Man City and Barcelona. For this upcoming game, the European Champions will have to do without Kvaratskhelia, Dembélé, Nuno Mendes and Marquinhos who all sustained injuries.
